title: Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits
authors: Dowon Kim; MinJae Lee; Janghyeon Kim; HyuckSung Kwon; Hyeonggyu Jeong; Sang-Soo Park; Minyong Yoon; Si-Dong Roh; Yongsuk Kwon; Jinin So; Jungwook Choi
venue_full: International Conference on Parallel Architectures and Compilation Techniques

problem_statement.en: Long-context LLM inference suffers from severe memory and compute bottlenecks due to the linear scaling of the KV-cache, which leads to costly data recall overheads and GPU memory pressure that limits batch sizes.
problem_statement.zh: 長 context LLM inference 因 KV cache 線性擴展而面臨嚴重的記憶體與計算瓶頸，導致高昂的資料召回開銷以及 GPU 記憶體壓力，進而限制 batch size。

key_innovation.en: A CXL-enabled Processing-Near-Memory (PNM) architecture that offloads KV-cache management and attention computation to PNM accelerators, combined with a hybrid GPU-PNM execution model using steady-token selection to maintain large batch sizes.
key_innovation.zh: 以 CXL 為基礎的 Processing-Near-Memory（PNM）架構：將 KV cache 管理與 attention 計算卸載至 PNM 加速器，並結合 GPU-PNM 混合執行模型與穩態 token 選擇策略，以維持大 batch size。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: NVIDIA DGX appliance with A100-80GB GPUs, ArkVale

key_improvements.en: Up to 21.9x throughput improvement, up to 60x lower energy per token, and up to 7.3x better total cost efficiency.
key_improvements.zh: throughput 最高提升 21.9x，每 token 能耗最高降低 60x，總體成本效率最高改善 7.3x。

experimental_setup.software_simulator: Cycle-level simulator parameterized by synthesized timing and power models
experimental_setup.network_topology: CXL switch-based shared memory pool, Rack-scale

workload_and_traffic.traffic_pattern: Tensor Parallelism, Data Parallelism, GPU-CXL DMA

hardware_infrastructure.compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-80GB, Intel 4th-generation Xeon CPU, LPDDR5X
